description: Lists the feedback reports this account has sent, newest first, with each one's current status. The server id is returned only once, when a report is sent, so this listing is how a report whose id was not kept is found again; it also shows whether a report landed and whether the team has acted on it. Optional filters by status or type; paging uses the cursor from a previous response. Free per call, not metered. Returns {feedback: [...], count, limit, next_cursor}; pages continue while next_cursor is non-null, and an account that has filed nothing gets an empty list and a 200, not an error. It lists SENT reports on the server, which differ from the unsent local drafts on this machine.

cursor.description: Optional. The next_cursor from a previous response, for the page after it. Keyset paging on (created_at, id), so a report filed during paging cannot make a row repeat or be skipped. A cursor this endpoint did not issue is a 400, not an empty page.

limit.description: Optional. How many are returned, 1 to 100 (default 25). Newest first.

status.description: Optional. Restricts the list to reports in this state; absent, every state.

type.description: Optional. Restricts the list to reports of this kind; absent, every kind.

name: reddit_feedback_list
